description: Decision Explanation Examples showing intake input, rules triggered, decision output, and audit reasoning

examples.scenario: Scenario 1: Happy Path Prime Applicant Auto-Approval

output.decisionReason: All mandatory eligibility criteria and risk threshold checks passed successfully.

examples.auditReasoning: Applicant satisfies all prime underwriting rules with low debt-to-income ratio (2.08x) and zero delinquent credit bureau records.

examples.scenario: Scenario 2: Borderline Credit Score Requiring Manual Underwriter Review

rulesTriggered.reason: Credit score between 600 and 719 requires manual underwriter review

output.decisionReason: Application flagged for manual review: Credit score between 600 and 719 requires manual underwriter review

examples.auditReasoning: Credit score 660 meets baseline floor (>= 600) but falls below prime auto-approval ceiling (720). Paused for secondary underwriter verification.

examples.scenario: Scenario 3: Mandatory Minimum Income Violation Rejection

rulesTriggered.reason: Minimum income requirement of 20,000 not met

output.decisionReason: Application rejected due to 1 failed check(s): Minimum income requirement of 20,000 not met

examples.auditReasoning: Hard rejection triggered during mandatory stage evaluation prior to credit disbursement.

examples.scenario: Scenario 4: External Dependency Outage & Recovery Flow

outagePhase.error: External dependency failure: Credit Bureau Service 503: External Dependency Unavailable (Simulated Failure)

examples.auditReasoning: System isolated third-party 503 error, transitioned state to FAILED without crashing, and successfully finalized evaluation when retried.
